Freedom+ Driver PMA supplement under FDA review — approval expected by end of 2026

MDR CE Mark (EU) re-certification in progress

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company — sole commercial product is the SynCardia Total Artificial Heart (FDA PMA-approved Class III device). No proprietary drug pipeline; all R&D programs (Emperor implantable TAH, Unicorn driver, Freedom+/Companion 3 drivers) are device development tracks pursued via 510(k)/PMA/PMA-supplement pathways, not P1/P2/P3 drug trials. Emperor is currently in animal/preclinical testing only.
